name: Shepherd's Pie
description: A classic shepherd's pie made with ground beef, mixed vegetables, and topped with mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef in an electric skillet. Drain excess fat.
Add onion soup mix, frozen vegetables, beef cube, salt, and pepper. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes.
Pour the mixture into a 6-cup (1.5 L) casserole dish or square baking dish.
Top with mashed potatoes and sprinkle with paprika if desired.
Bake at 400°F for 15 to 20 minutes, until the potatoes are firm and golden brown.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes, casserole

_similar.name: English Shepherd's Pie
_similar.description: A traditional shepherd's pie with ground beef, vegetables, and mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef briskly over high heat. Drain off excess fat.
Add the chopped onion and reduce heat. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the meat is well browned.
Sprinkle the flour over the meat mixture and stir to coat evenly.
Gradually add water, stock cube, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, bay leaf, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Add the can of peas to the meat mixture.
Transfer the meat mixture to a casserole dish and cover with mashed potatoes.
Bake in a 400°F oven until the top is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes

_similar.name: Rosemary Shipwreck Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, potatoes, and a tomato-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a large bowl, combine beef, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Place potatoes in the bottom of a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Top potatoes with chopped onion.
Cover onion layer with the beef mixture.
Spoon pork and beans over the beef layer.
Pour tomato soup over the pork and beans.
Cover the casserole and bake for 1 hour or until done.

_similar.keywords: shipwreck casserole, ground beef, potato casserole

_similar.name: Taco Twist Bake
_similar.description: A hearty taco-flavored pasta bake with ground beef, spaghetti sauce, and melted cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start water to cook for pasta.
In a frying pan, brown the ground beef with the onions until the meat is no longer pink. Drain off excess fat.
Add mushrooms, taco seasoning, and water. Simmer for about 15 minutes.
Add spaghetti sauce, salsa, and green pepper. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes more.
Cook the spiral pasta, then rinse and drain.
Combine pasta with sour cream.
Pour the pasta mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish or square baking dish.
Sprinkle with approximately half of the shredded cheddar cheese.
Cover with the meat mixture and bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: taco pasta bake, ground beef recipe, cheesy casserole

_similar.name: Spaghetti Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty spaghetti casserole with ground beef, canned tomatoes, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of mushroom soup

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef and onion in a frying pan.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Transfer cooked spaghetti to a 2-quart casserole dish.
Pour canned tomatoes over the spaghetti layer.
Spoon the browned meat mixture over the tomatoes.
Cover with cream of mushroom soup.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes, uncovered, until cheese starts to get bubbly.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti casserole, ground beef, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food
